methodology.outcome: Season N preseason ADP minus Season N+1 preseason ADP
methodology.thresholdRationale: Two 12-team rounds is a predetermined economically visible change; four and six rounds define major and elite appreciation.
methodology.predictors: Frozen Season N usage and development features only.

survivorship.conclusion: Historical-only identities materially expand sample coverage; inference should not be restricted to survivors in the 2026 pool.
